evidence.characterization: Residual tmux teardown and pane-predicate timeouts on macOS arm64 under load. No assertion-shaped signature remains: an assertion that fails here blocks.

ctrl_x_assertion_resolved.result: The Ctrl-X isolation probe was not flaky. It searched recorded input frames for the C0 byte 0x18 while the terminal sent the CSI-u form ESC[120;5u, so it failed constantly wherever that keyboard protocol is active, and a thirty second retry loop disguised a constant failure as a slow one. Matching either encoding and asserting against a settled tape produced 5 of 5 clean runs of the three declared probes, each in about three seconds rather than thirty.

bb2_replay_review.result: Reviewed the complete 74ec5fa5 to 0e747981 blob delta. It carries upstream's single full-detail surface changes, bounded paging helpers, and the deterministic settled-response fixture used by the replayed terminal probe. The three quarantined tests still admit only tmux teardown or pane-predicate timeouts; no assertion signature was added.

phase_1c_candidate_review.result: Reviewed the changed quarantined inputs against the prior pins. The subagent fixture and shared tmux helper only accommodate the revised post-tool decision prompt; the three selected probe names and their ownership remain unchanged. The replay fixture moves automatic recording behind debug controls, continues to assert its private tape, and adds a silent-banner Ctrl-O probe outside the six selected names. The test-name patterns and the two runtime-only timeout signatures are unchanged, so assertion failures and every undeclared failure still block.

launch_provider_candidate_review.result: Reviewed the complete 4f2a8281 to 6311f180 blob delta. It changes only the separate configure-duration restart test to accept any later durable generation and assert that observed generation. None of the three selected quarantine probes, their names, shared tmux helper, or allowed runtime-only timeout signatures changes; assertion failures and every undeclared failure still block.

phase_2_candidate_review.result: Reviewed the macOS x86_64 shard-3 durable-generation correction: configured generation now advances beyond the initial value, and the withDuration expectation binds its generation. Focused native E2E passed.

dd717_integration_review.result: Reviewed the complete prior-pinned-to-candidate deltas for both quarantined inputs. The shared tmux helper retains the model-facing shell.run fixture and adds only the pure canonicalSubagentIdForStore adapter for upstream's reversible compact child handles. The subagent file adopts upstream's wrapped managed run request and task-derived display label, removes unrelated tests, and keeps all three selected probe names unique. The isolation and always-approval probes retain their ownership, canonical-scope, external-write, and permission assertions; the selected-child approval probe is unchanged. The render/replay test blob is unchanged. The cf98de5c-to-b8cd5938 merge records the recomposed hosted and state/auth carry ancestry without changing tree c60275df. The b8cd5938-to-27689151 delta changes only the non-quarantined tests/e2e/ade-event-feed.test.ts fixture from internal command.create to wrapped subagent.run, asserts its task-derived display label, and retains its bounded child shell.run command. No assertion signature is admitted: only the two existing runtime timeout shapes remain quarantinable.

provider_version_helper_review.result: Reviewed the complete f0a06767-to-e3ea787f shared tmux-helper delta. It removes one unused classifier evidence accessor and routes requested environments through providerVersionTestEnv, which injects a pinned Codex client version only when a test supplies a Codex model-catalog URL without its own version source. The quarantined render/replay file supplies no such URL, so its runtime environment is unchanged. All six selected test names and the two runtime-only timeout signatures remain unchanged; assertions and undeclared failures still block.

upstream_bounded_terminal.result: The three declared subagent probes produced 2 pass and the same Ctrl-X assertion failure, which is now understood as the encoding defect above rather than as fragility; all six render/replay probes passed after the upstream test added explicit terminal deadlines
